add.title: Add backgrounds
add.description: Each background is an image of exactly {{width}} × {{height}} px, like the model input. Generation pastes objects onto backgrounds; annotation happens in the images section.

ready.title: Ready frames
ready.hint: Files already of the right size, imported as they are.

images.title: Cut from images
images.hint: Large screenshots: you place a frame on each file.

video.title: Cut from video
video.hint: One frame for the whole video, a shot every N seconds.

ready.note: Files of another size are not imported: they go to the “Skip reasons” of the run with their actual size.
ready.selected: Files selected: {{number}}. Of the right size {{width}} × {{height}}: <exact>{{exact}}</exact> will be imported.
ready.largerHint: Large files can be cut with a frame: “Cut from images”.

images.note: Files show one by one: place a {{width}} × {{height}} px frame on each. Files of exactly this size are taken whole, smaller ones are skipped. Samples come before the import.

blur.title: Background blur
blur.description: Optional. Each background gets a Gaussian blur with a random radius from the range, imitating a blurred world behind a translucent panel. A radius below 0.3 px leaves the background sharp. Applies to every way of adding.
blur.seedHint: The same seed gives the same radii on a repeat. An empty field picks a seed automatically and keeps it in the run.

errors.numbers: Enter the “from” and “to” radius as numbers.
errors.range: The radius is from 0 to {{max}} px.
errors.order: The “from” radius cannot exceed the “to” radius.
errors.seed: Advanced: the seed is an integer from 0 to 4,294,967,295 or an empty field.

video.title: Cut from video
video.description: One {{width}} × {{height}} px frame for the whole video: this region is cut from every taken shot.
video.started: The job has started: its progress and result are in the preparation history. Choose the video again for the next run.
video.choosePrompt: Choose a video: an example shot appears to place the frame on.
video.skipSimilarHint: A shot almost the same as one already taken (a still camera, a pause) does not count; the next one is taken instead. With few distinct shots there will be fewer backgrounds than requested.
video.startHint: Useful to skip an intro or a menu at the start of the video.
video.available_one: Up to {{count}} shot is available with this step.
video.available_other: Up to {{count}} shots are available with this step.

errors.tooSmall: The video {{width}}×{{height}} is smaller than the model input {{targetWidth}}×{{targetHeight}}: the frame does not fit.
errors.region: The frame goes beyond the shot.
errors.interval: The step is a positive number of seconds.
errors.start: The start is from 0 to {{seconds}} s.
errors.count: The number of backgrounds is a positive integer.
errors.tooMany_one: With a step of {{interval}} s the video gives at most {{count}} background. Reduce the step or the count.
errors.tooMany_other: With a step of {{interval}} s the video gives at most {{count}} backgrounds. Reduce the step or the count.

crop.title: Cut backgrounds from images
crop.pickHint: File {{position}} of {{total}}. Drag the {{width}} × {{height}} px frame to the right place: the frame equals the model input and does not resize. Arrows move it by 1 px, with Shift by 10 px.
crop.reviewHint: Check the samples and start the import. Cut backgrounds appear in the set as they are processed.
crop.small: Smaller than the model input, skipped: {{number}}
crop.tooMany_one: One run can cut up to {{count}} file. Skip some files or cut in several runs.
crop.tooMany_other: One run can cut up to {{count}} files. Skip some files or cut in several runs.
crop.nothing: Nothing to import: no file is chosen.
